scope: exact even completion-deficit gcd, including two-adic correction; all primitive natural coordinate pairs

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.padicValNat_pow_sub_pow_of_four_dvd
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_pow_sub_pow_of_four_dvd
    {a b n : ℕ} (hab : b < a) (hn : n ≠ 0) (h4 : 4 ∣ a - b) (ha : ¬ 2 ∣ a) :
    padicValNat 2 (a ^ n - b ^ n) = padicValNat 2 (a - b) + padicValNat 2 n

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.padicValNat_powerDifferenceCofactor_add_gap
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_powerDifferenceCofactor_add_gap
    {q a b n : ℕ} [Fact q.Prime] (hab : b < a) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat q (powerDifferenceCofactor n a b) + padicValNat q (a - b) =
      padicValNat q (a ^ n - b ^ n)

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.padicValNat_powerDifferenceCofactor_of_odd_prime
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_powerDifferenceCofactor_of_odd_prime
    {q a b n : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hodd : Odd q) (hab : b < a) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hgap : q ∣ a - b) (ha : ¬ q ∣ a) :
    padicValNat q (powerDifferenceCofactor n a b) = padicValNat q n

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.padicValNat_powerDifferenceCofactor_of_four_dvd
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_powerDifferenceCofactor_of_four_dvd
    {a b n : ℕ} (hab : b < a) (hn : n ≠ 0) (h4 : 4 ∣ a - b) (ha : ¬ 2 ∣ a) :
    padicValNat 2 (powerDifferenceCofactor n a b) = padicValNat 2 n

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.padicValNat_squared_cofactor_of_dvd_sum
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_squared_cofactor_of_dvd_sum
    {q m x y : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hyx : y < x)
    (hxy : x.Coprime y) (hqs : q ∣ x + y) :
    padicValNat q (powerDifferenceCofactor m (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2)) = padicValNat q m

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.padicValNat_even_cofactor_of_dvd_sum
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem padicValNat_even_cofactor_of_dvd_sum
    {q m x y : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hyx : y < x)
    (hxy : x.Coprime y) (hqs : q ∣ x + y) :
    padicValNat q (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * m) x y) =
      padicValNat q (x + y) + padicValNat q m

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_eq_of_padicValNat_eq_on_support
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_eq_of_padicValNat_eq_on_support
    {a b c : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hv : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ c → padicValNat q a = padicValNat q b) :
    Nat.gcd a c = Nat.gcd b c

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_squared_cofactor_sum_pow
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_squared_cofactor_sum_pow
    {m x y : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hyx : y < x) (hxy : x.Coprime y) (N : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2)) ((x + y) ^ N) =
      Nat.gcd m ((x + y) ^ N)

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_even_cofactor_defect_eq_mul_gcd_squared
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_even_cofactor_defect_eq_mul_gcd_squared
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (x y : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * m) x y) (completionDefect (2 * m) x y) =
      (x + y) * Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor m (x ^ 2) (y ^ 2))
        ((x + y) ^ (2 * m - 2))

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_even_cofactor_completionDefect_of_lt
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_even_cofactor_completionDefect_of_lt
    {m x y : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hyx : y < x) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * m) x y) (completionDefect (2 * m) x y) =
      (x + y) * Nat.gcd m ((x + y) ^ (2 * m - 2))

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_even_cofactor_completionDefect
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_even_cofactor_completionDefect
    {m x y : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor (2 * m) x y) (completionDefect (2 * m) x y) =
      (x + y) * Nat.gcd m ((x + y) ^ (2 * m - 2))

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_cofactor_completionDefect_of_even
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_cofactor_completionDefect_of_even
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn : Even n) (hn0 : 0 < n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) (completionDefect n x y) =
      (x + y) * Nat.gcd (n / 2) ((x + y) ^ (n - 2))

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_cofactor_completionDefect
new_theorems.source_signature:
theorem gcd_cofactor_completionDefect
    {n x y : ℕ} (hn0 : 0 < n) (hxy : x.Coprime y) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor n x y) (completionDefect n x y) =
      if Odd n then 1 else (x + y) * Nat.gcd (n / 2) ((x + y) ^ (n - 2))

new_theorems.name: DkMath.Lib.NumberTheory.gcd_zero_cofactor_completionDefect
new_theorems.source_signature:
@[simp] theorem gcd_zero_cofactor_completionDefect (x y : ℕ) :
    Nat.gcd (powerDifferenceCofactor 0 x y) (completionDefect 0 x y) = 1
